html:
Precision Steel. Delivered with Confidence.

At Dass Metal Products, we believe that every strong build begins with the right materials. That’s why contractors across Ontario rely on our metal framing systems—designed for durability, precision, and consistent performance.

As part of the JDass Corp group, Dass Metal offers a wide range of precision-engineered steel components trusted in commercial, mid-rise, and residential construction projects.

We specialize in everything from non-load bearing steel studs (light gauge) to load-bearing framing systems (heavy gauge)—giving you the structural backbone your project needs.

Products You Can Rely On

Searching for metal studs in Ontario, steel supply near me, or a trusted partner for metal framing systems? Look no further. Dass Metal Products offers an extensive catalog of engineered steel products, including:

  • Standard Track Products
  • Slotted Deflection Track
  • Bridging / Carrying Channel
  • Windbrace, U-Flex Track, Furring Channel
  • L Track, Z-Bar, 90°/130° Cornerbeads
  • Shaftwall Components, J Track, J Trim, L Trim
  • Clips, Tie Wires, Hanger Wires, Flat Strips
  • Special Profiles tailored to unique project needs

We’re not just a metal distributor near you—we’re your strategic partner in quality, reliability, and timely delivery.

Why Steel?

Contractors choose steel framing studs over wood or concrete because of one word: performance. Steel framing is straight, precise, lightweight, and cost-effective. In today’s fast-paced builds, steel means faster installation, better results, and long-term durability—even in harsh Canadian climates.

At Dass Metal, every piece of sheet metal or steel component is engineered to meet industry standards and project specs.

What Sets Dass Metal Apart

✔️ Canadian Made – Our products are manufactured in Canada for Canadian weather and building codes
✔️ Quick Turnaround – We fulfill orders fast to keep your build on schedule
✔️ Custom Profiles – We fabricate what you need, when you need it
✔️ On-Site Knowledge – Our team works with real builders, so we understand what it takes on site

A Supplier You Can Count On

Our clients span every sector of the construction industry:

  • General Contractors
  • Architects and Engineers
  • Drywall and Framing Subcontractors
  • Steel Distributors and Warehouses

If you’re looking for steel suppliers in the GTA or a dependable source among steel distributors near you, Dass Metal Products is your trusted partner.

Trusted by Builders. Backed by JDass Corp.

As part of the JDass Corp group, Dass Metal Products upholds a deep-rooted commitment to service, quality, and trust. We don’t just supply steel—we support the structures shaping Ontario’s future.

From mid-rise condos and commercial plazas to hotels and towers, contractors rely on our expertise, efficient logistics, and quality control.
